The dataset contains 15 records across 6 columns covering a date range from 2025-01-01 to 2025-06-15, documenting revenue, units, regions, accounts, and products.

The data tracks transactional performance with 4 regions, 5 accounts, and 3 distinct product types, showing a wide variation in revenue between 1200.0 and 4500.0.
